title: Add makefile target to conclude the tournament and crown a season winner
description:
Add `make conclude-tournament` that:

1. Reads the current tournament from data/season.json -> data/tournaments/season-N.json
2. Verifies all rounds are complete (the bracket has a final winner)
3. Records the season champion in the tournament JSON
4. Transitions the season: bumps current_season in data/season.json to N+1, resets phase to 'regular-season', clears the tournament pointer
5. Prints a summary of the tournament results

This unblocks `make run` for the next season's regular-season games. The completed tournament file stays in data/tournaments/ as a historical record.

Consider also:
- Whether Elo ratings should carry over or reset between seasons
- Whether the active preset pool should be reviewed at season boundaries
- Archiving the season's leaderboard snapshot
